# Strategic Regional Sales Leader

 6 days ago 

Apply

* * *

 MN United States, MN Toshiba International Corporation Full-time 

Free with email or Google

## Save this job and keep your search organized

Create a free account to save jobs, create alerts and return to this listing from your dashboard.

Save jobSave and create alert

Free with email or Google

By continuing, you agree to our Terms&Privacy Policy.

Toshiba International Corporation is seeking a Regional Sales Manager to drive growth in an assigned district. You will lead and coach sales staff, coordinate with marketing, engineering, and service teams, and manage key accounts to expand market share.

Travel up to 60% across the region is expected; a proven sales record and at least three years of experience are required. The role reports to the Regional Sales Manager and offers growth opportunities.

 #J-18808-Ljbffr
